title: Boston read-only run: an existing damaged-sign request is already open
summary: A real public Open311 record was inspected in read-only mode. The existing request is still open, so this run stops as a duplicate and prepares no new submission.

evidence.supports: The public Open311 record reports request 101006740558 as open under Damaged Sign. Address, coordinates, media, and token are omitted from this card.
The public service catalog maps the Damaged Sign category to the published sign-repair service code.

stop_reason.reason: An existing public request covers the observed issue. Sending another request would add noise and is not prepared by this read-only run.

privacy.redaction_notes: The API response fields address, coordinates, media URL, description, and token were not copied into the public card.

checks: Service catalog GET returned HTTP 200 with 10 categories
